svg.text: ibd [System] Grid-Tie Inverter — power, sensing, control and protection
comparator window on chain B voltage
latch → gate disable + relay B open
string fuses 1000 V gPV, reverse diodes
Relay A + Relay B in series (independent drivers)
grid voltage ×2 independent isolated chains (A → STM32 ADC, B → hardware trip) · AC current (perturbation check) · DC voltage · per-string current

chain A: grid V, I, DC
DC line keep-alive / shutdown signal to module devices
